title: Spinning to the Metronome (Xtra Loop (Spin))
description: I have a metronome, I bought it forever ago always intending to use it in a file. So while working on "Neurogenesis", part of it was using a metronome to condition a pleasure trigger, I recorded the one I bought for a bit. Anyways, my bright idea was to play with it in spin, and edit it around, so that it starts slowly circling your head, then moving faster and faster; not in how fast they go, but how fast it spins. I thought that you all might enjoy playing with those first loops I experimented with yourself, and layering them into other files.
author: Mistress Shibby
